title: Regression verification + TypeScript strict check across all modified files
description: Final verification wave: run full test suite, TypeScript strict check, and verify no regressions from the security hardening changes. Fix any remaining test failures caused by validation changes.
action: Run npx tsc --noEmit to verify zero TypeScript errors. Run npx vitest run to verify zero test regressions. If any tests fail due to validation changes (e.g., 400→413 status code changes, path containment rejects), fix the test expectations to match the new correct behavior. Verify grep confirms zero NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE references in source files.

criteria: npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0 (zero TypeScript errors)
npx vitest run exits with code 0 (zero test failures)
grep -r 'NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE' src-ts/mcp/endpoints/ src-ts/mcp/services/ src-ts/reader/mcp/ src-ts/services/ --include='*.ts' --exclude='*.test.ts' returns 0 matches
grep -r 'safeResolveWorkspaceRoot' src-ts/mcp/endpoints/ src-ts/mcp/services/ src-ts/reader/mcp/ src-ts/services/ --include='*.ts' returns >= 11 matches
convergence.definition_of_done: Zero TypeScript errors, zero test failures, all security validators in place across codebase

files.change: Fix any test expectations broken by validation changes (status code 400→413, path containment errors)

implementation: Run npx tsc --noEmit — fix any TypeScript errors
Run npx vitest run — capture any test failures

For each failing test, determine if failure is caused by: (a) status code change 400→413 for length overflow — update test expectation to 413; (b) safeResolveWorkspaceRoot rejecting test workspace path — update test to use cwd subdirectory or mock safeResolveWorkspaceRoot; (c) validateWeight rejecting NaN/Infinity in existing test data — update test to use valid weight values or add explicit NaN test cases
Run npx vitest run again after fixes to confirm green
Run grep verification: zero NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE in source files, 11+ safeResolveWorkspaceRoot references, 7+ validateStringLength in reader-endpoints.ts
Final npx tsc --noEmit + npx vitest run — both must exit 0

rationale.chosen_approach: Final wave ensures everything integrates cleanly. Wide-scope refactors (11 file workspace path change, 7 endpoint length guards, weight validation) can cause cascading test failures that need targeted fixes.
decision_factors: Safety net — catch regressions before declaring done
Status code changes from 400→413 need test expectation updates
Path containment may reject existing test fixture paths

risks.risk: Full test suite may reveal failures in files not directly modified (e.g., tests that mock resolveWorkspaceRoot but don't expect the new function name)
risks.mitigation: Search for resolveWorkspaceRoot and resolveWorkflowWorkspace mocks in test files and update to mock safeResolveWorkspaceRoot instead
